GeometricTraceR3.actual_geometric_trace_transfer.{u_1} {H : Type u_1} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H]
  [CompleteSpace H] (M : Submodule ℂ H) [CompleteSpace ↥M] (A : H →L[ℂ] H) (hA : ∀ x ∈ M, A x ∈ M)
  (hB : IsTraceClass ((GeometricTraceR3.spectralToPerp M).comp (A.comp Mᗮ.subtypeL))) :
  IsTraceClass ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - M.starProjection).comp A) ∧
    trace ((ContinuousLinearMap.id ℂ H - M.starProjection).comp A) =
      trace ((GeometricTraceR3.spectralToPerp M).comp (A.comp Mᗮ.subtypeL))
